notes.text: The frozen cross-reference has נדיה (Nadiah); the provenance OCR had גדיה (Gediah).

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume III, printed p. 949, reads נריה. ערך גדיה: Neriah, see Gediah. The frozen transcription instead reads נדיה, which the English retains with its Hebrew spelling. The earlier note records this variant before the printed-page inspection. This is a bare cross-reference, not a biography; no destination entry or person is automatically identified. The displayed heading retains the existing catalog label נריה.
